name: zeffect_anim_save_running_anim_record
description: zEffect_Anim::SaveRunningAnimRecord serializes one Running### temp stream with header, surface runtime/event bytes, light refs, and sound refs, then flushes it into the active ZBD writer.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x460bc0 builds a 0x68 running-record header, formats Running%03d, opens a zUtil_ZBD temp write stream, writes the header, writes each 0x40 surface runtime with currentEvent converted to an event-stream offset and appends event bytes when eventStreamSize > 0.

The same function writes each 0x38 light ref and 0x3c sound ref while writes continue to succeed, using zClass_Sound::gwSoundGetPosition for saved runtime positions and zClass::NodePtrToValidatedIndex for saved parent indices.
It calls zUtil_ZBD::FlushTempWriteStreamToSectionRecord(tmpStream, callbackCtx, sectionName) before returning the accumulated fwrite success flag.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification remains deferred to a coherent zEffect animation save/load source-cluster pass.
